content:
Sam (CEO): Thanks for a packed all-hands. Dropping this thread for security/privacy follow-ups so we can hand off actions.
Daphne (Head of Security): I'll field Qs. Please flag anything that needs a customer-facing blurb.
Priya (Solutions): Customers asked about Hosted BYOK support and audit log export options.
Daphne (Head of Security): BYOK roadmap: AWS KMS + GCP KMS targeted mid-Q4; Azure Key Vault after that. Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM today.
Nora (Compliance): Audit logs: default control-plane retention is 90 days. Enterprise/Dedicated can opt into 365 days. We're adding S3/BigQuery export hooks next quarter.
Ilya (NetEng): Connectivity Qs: recommend AWS PrivateLink for Hosted-to-customer connections. We'll publish a region-by-region endpoint list and minimal egress rules.
Priya (Solutions): Can we get a one-page "security at Redwood" for the Console and a customer one-pager comparing Hosted/Dedicated/Private?
Daphne (Head of Security): Yes. Action: Daphne + Nora + Priya to draft the Console FAQ + customer one-pager. ETA: next Tuesday.
Sam (CEO): Also please publish the SOC2 roadmap and auditor once finalized. Keep this thread updated with links.
doc-bot: Draft created: /docs/security/console-security-faq-draft.md (internal). Link: https://intranet.redwood/docs/security/console-security-faq-draft (reaction: :white_check_mark:)
Daphne (Head of Security): Noted. If any sales or CSM folks need a customer briefing, DM me and Nora and we'll run a short slide deck. :lock:
